entities.description: A full-body side profile of a dark-skinned, pregnant woman walking to the right, wearing minimal traditional adornments including a beaded belt, armbands, and leg wraps, with a distinctive tall, spiky hairstyle and a strap across her shoulder.

A full-body side profile of a dark-skinned man standing on reddish-brown dirt, holding a wooden staff in his raised right hand. He is wearing traditional adornments including a beaded necklace, a beaded loincloth, a green beaded armband, and a white anklet, with his body appearing to be covered in a dark substance.

A full-body side profile of a standing woman with dark skin, likely of African descent, wearing traditional adornments including a beaded headpiece, neck rings, and armbands. She has a prominent, large belly and is wearing a white strap across her back and a red string around her waist, standing on a sandy surface against a plain orange-brown background.

attributes.hair: black, styled in a high, spiky topknot

accessories.head: beaded headband and netting
accessories.arms: beaded armbands and a white cuff with red band

attributes.background: solid orange-brown, textured like sand or earth
